sourceOfTruth.models: Fresh OpenRouter catalog plus exact native identities admitted by role-policy.json.
sourceOfTruth.roles: role-policy.json; this portfolio must neither invent nor omit a routed role.
sourceOfTruth.cases: Closed cases in depot-role-benchmark-suite.json plus the explicitly classified Baseplate prototypes below.
sourceOfTruth.results: Private immutable receipts below /home/ned/benchmark-results; Git contains only contracts, hashes, grids, and content-free aggregate evidence.

maintenance.scope: Reconstruct every model-role cell; call only changed, stale, rotating-incumbent, or unresolved high-value cells.

fullAudit.scope: Screen every eligible model-role cell with a sealed case, then deepen only decision-relevant candidates.

caseStatuses.closed-runnable: Integrated with the standard deterministic runner.
caseStatuses.prototype-sealed: Prompt and deterministic assertions are preserved, but evidence materialization is not yet integrated with the standard runner.
caseStatuses.prototype-unsealed: A prior experiment exists, but its complete prompt/scorer contract was not retained well enough to claim reproducibility.
caseStatuses.planned-gap: Required portfolio coverage with no retained benchmark evidence yet.

roles.gap: The closed case is too small to prove federated architecture, rollout, and operational judgment.
No sealed case checks whether a critic catches protocol, trust, update, rollback, and team-size failures in another plan.
Current cases prove structured mechanical output, not repository edits or validation.
Prior scoped-DB output was retained, but the exact task/scorer was not made reproducible; frontend implementation remains untested.
The closed case measures classification, not attributable findings on a real patch.
No sealed repository review measures correct findings, false positives, or verification contribution.
No sealed case tests trust, nonce, SSRF, grant, key-change, revocation, and independent-family sign-off boundaries.
The evidence-bound scorer is reproducible, but source discovery and the standard runner are not covered.
No sealed case measures technically exact, operator-appropriate release communication.

cases.measurement: Produce a bounded Go patch and validate exact repository behavior without changing unrelated contracts.
cases.missingProof: The original exact prompt, fixture state, and deterministic scorer were not retained as a single sealed artifact.

cases.measurement: Choose and defend a pull, push, or hybrid compatibility-observation design for sovereign 4-50-user installs, including protocol evolution, trust, offline behavior, update truth, rollback, observability, and a two-install verification matrix.
cases.missingProof: The task hash and three-attempt outputs exist, but the exact scorer and evidence-builder were not retained beside the run.

cases.measurement: Produce an evidence-bound compatibility recommendation for exact Go, Templ, Datastar Go, and NATS/JetStream pins while rejecting two synthetic unsupported claims.
cases.missingProof: Tool-enabled source discovery and standard-runner integration are absent.

cases.measurement: Review a seeded federation architecture plan and retain every protocol, trust, update, rollback, operability, and scope finding with calibrated severity.
Review a seeded Go patch for scoping escape, transaction misuse, SQL behavior, concurrency, test gaps, and unsupported findings.
Find seeded trust, nonce, SSRF, grant, key-change, revocation, data-minimization, and family-independence defects without inventing vulnerabilities.
Implement a bounded Templ, Datastar, and Live Wires interaction with generated-code, browser, accessibility, and repository validation gates.
Write an operator-facing release note that distinguishes running, staged, failed, rolled-back, and deliberately downgraded versions across federated installs.

roleGaps.reason: No current role directly owns Templ, Datastar, Live Wires, browser, responsive, and accessibility implementation. Builder-deep is only a temporary measurement host.
roleGaps.promotionBoundary: Do not add the role from benchmark preference alone; first prove a distinct routing need and update role-policy consumers and validators.

promotionPolicy.screen: One retained successful attempt is nomination evidence only.
promotionPolicy.controlled: Three retained successful attempts on every applicable closed case, no model fallback, no case median below 90, and complete compatible claimed-axis coverage.
promotionPolicy.canary: A new paid candidate enters only as a later rung.
promotionPolicy.head: Role-head movement additionally requires at least five attributable production attempts with acceptable completion, fallback, retry, and first-pass validation evidence.
